cases.prompt: Build me a knowledge graph from these documents
cases.expect_behavior: ontology first, then extraction, then fusion

cases.prompt: Extract entities and relations from this text
cases.expect_behavior: name the entity types before extracting

cases.prompt: How do I add GraphRAG to my agent?
Two records look like the same company
cases.expect_behavior: entity resolution with a stated match rule
worked examples per stage, not a definition list

cases.prompt: My agent keeps looping without stopping. How do I structure it?
cases.expect_behavior: name loop engineering: a bound and an exit decided by exit codes, not the model

cases.prompt: Should I use chain of thought or tree of thoughts here?
cases.expect_behavior: route to prompt engineering and pick the cheapest that works, chain unless the problem forks

cases.prompt: How do I stop an agent from touching things it shouldn't?
cases.expect_behavior: runtime engineering: make it unreachable in the harness, not forbidden in the prompt
